<data name="request">
the recent m210210 experiments - does the dust law have 2175 angstrom bump? is the bump enabled in the model
</data>

<data name="answer key">
Yes. The fits use the Noll attenuation law with a Drude bump centred at 2175 A (FWHM 350 A, Kriek & Conroy 2013 centre and width). The bump amplitude E_bump (diffuse_Ebump) is a free parameter, independent of the slope delta; production prior Uniform(0, 6). (Some 29-30 Sep M1_210210 arms sampled E_bump on Uniform(0, 12).)
</data>

<data name="final reply">
Yes, the bump is on.
